items.raw_excerpt: The Netherlands had 19,435 fast food outlets at the start of 2026, an increase of 88% since 2007, according to figures published on Wednesday by national statistics agency CBS. The count covers cafeterias, sandwich shops, food stalls and ice cream parlours, which now make up slightly more than half of all the country’s 38,600 food outlets.
